articles.title: Plants can speak using electricity, so this startup built an AI model to decipher their language
articles.summary: Electric Plant has built an AI-powered translator to help humans listen to what plants are saying with the subtle electricity coursing through their stems.

articles.title: Eka is worth $1.45B thanks to a physical AI model that has experts raving
articles.summary: Eka Robotics may be the first robotic arm that is actually good at picking a wide range of objects up, and it is so smooth and human-like, it is wowing the industry.

articles.title: Otter.ai raises $320 million from General Catalyst’s growth fund for its meeting tool
articles.summary: Meeting note-taking tool Otter.ai announced on Tuesday that it has raised $320 million from General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund (CVF), which provides capital to startups without diluting equity and gets returns on the results of marketing spend. Otter.ai said that it will use these funds for enterprise growth, go-to-market strategy, international expansion, and product innovation. […]

articles.title: Spotify pulled 50 million AI slop and spam tracks from its recommendations
articles.summary: Spotify says it has removed more than 50 million songs considered AI-generated slop or spam from user recommendations over the past year. That's according to an announcement on Tuesday that says Spotify has also made changes to its recommendation system to highlight more music made by human artists. articles.title: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life
articles.summary: AI companion app Tolan has raised another $30 million after attracting more than 250,000 active users.

articles.title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
articles.summary: After drawing acquisition interest earlier this year, the Nvidia challenger raised $1.5 billion to remain independent.

articles.title: ReactOS reaches major milestone with NTFS install support
articles.summary: ReactOS gains NTFS install support with new driver.

articles.title: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
articles.summary: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.
